comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: This data does not change, so why do we need a ref?
comments.label_reasoning: Using a ref for static/constant data is unnecessary complexity; a plain const would suffice.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/3c03f289b48b251c72ca333a6393322a9e568672

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Implies the ref should be removed or replaced with a plain variable since the data doesn't change.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: The ticket mentions Try Playground will change to something else as well.
comments.label_reasoning: The comment flags that the code does not reflect the full requirements from the ticket, indicating a semantic or specification gap.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/3c03f289b48b251c72ca333a6393322a9e568672

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Don't we need e.preventDefault() or stopPropogation ?
comments.label_reasoning: Missing preventDefault() or stopPropagation() on an event handler can cause unintended default browser behavior or event bubbling, which is a logic/behavioral defect.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/3c03f289b48b251c72ca333a6393322a9e568672

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests adding e.preventDefault() or stopPropagation() to the event handler.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Why do we need this v-if?
comments.label_reasoning: Questioning whether a v-if is necessary implies it may be redundant or unnecessary conditional logic.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/3c03f289b48b251c72ca333a6393322a9e568672

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Please move all the data into the script
comments.label_reasoning: Data defined in the template rather than the script section is a structural/organization issue in Vue SFC conventions.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/3c03f289b48b251c72ca333a6393322a9e568672

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Explicit request to move data into the script section.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Why are we mixing tailwind and css?
comments.label_reasoning: Mixing Tailwind utility classes with scoped CSS violates a project style convention for Vue/CSS usage.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: I am not sure why but tailwind was not getting applied to the border.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags a style inconsistency between Tailwind and plain CSS, implying they should be consolidated.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: The icons should be part of this repo, not directly linked to an external site
comments.label_reasoning: Linking icons from an external site rather than bundling them in the repo creates an external dependency and is a project structure/architecture concern.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/3c03f289b48b251c72ca333a6393322a9e568672

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Requests that icons be moved into the repo rather than linked from an external site.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Live editor uses the URL to store diagram, we don't want it to be polluted with tracking data. 

```suggestion
              'https://mermaid.live/edit',
```
comments.label_reasoning: Including tracking parameters in the URL pollutes the live editor's URL-based state storage, causing behavior that deviates from the intended functionality.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/3c03f289b48b251c72ca333a6393322a9e568672

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Provides a direct code suggestion to remove tracking parameters from the URL.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: ```suggestion ```
comments.label_reasoning: The suggestion enforces idiomatic Vue/Tailwind attribute ordering and class naming conventions specific to the project.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/3c03f289b48b251c72ca333a6393322a9e568672

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Avoid using mr-2, mb-4, etc. Use flex and gaps as necessary. ```suggestion
  • {{ featureName }}
    • ```
comments.label_reasoning: Preferring flex+gap over margin utilities (mr-2, mb-4) is a Tailwind CSS convention/best practice being enforced here.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/3c03f289b48b251c72ca333a6393322a9e568672

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Provides a direct code suggestion to replace margin utilities with flex/gap layout.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Instead of using index here, use a boolean flag in the column object, like `highlighted: true`.
Remove all the use of index.
comments.label_reasoning: Using an index to track a boolean property is a poor variable handling approach; a dedicated boolean flag in the data object is clearer and more maintainable.

comments.author: rajat-ht
comments.body: Updated in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/6609/commits/5fe0f53179f084111d35f923c0ed6b72c311c3ea

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Requests replacing index-based logic with a boolean flag in the column object and removing all index usage.
